behavioral_intents: Detect execution of Windows system binaries (lsass.exe, svchost.exe, cmd.exe, powershell.exe, etc.) from non-standard paths such as user directories, temp folders, or AppData, which indicates binary masquerading or suspicious relocation of legitimate system tools.
Detect attackers staging encoded payloads in registry as part of scheduled task persistence mechanisms, typically invoked by system binaries during installation or WMI operations.
Detect data exfiltration via text sharing and paste sites by monitoring outbound TCP connections from development tools (VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, GitHub Desktop) to known paste/bin services

Detect system binaries being executed from user-writable directories rather than their legitimate system locations, a common masquerading technique where attackers copy legitimate binaries to user-accessible paths.
Detect base64-encoded payloads staged in HKCU registry hives for later execution by scheduled tasks, a persistence and execution technique.
